business-website.title: Business Website
business-website.description: A professional, mobile-friendly website that makes your business look credible and trustworthy online. Built to load fast, rank on Google, and turn visitors into customers.

online-store.title: Online Store
online-store.description: A complete e-commerce website where customers can browse products, add to cart, and pay online directly through your own website. You keep 100% of every sale with no marketplace commission.
whatYouGet: Product catalogue with search and filters

online-booking-system.title: Online Booking System
online-booking-system.description: Let your customers book appointments online 24/7 — even while you're sleeping. Reduce missed calls, eliminate scheduling confusion, and send automatic reminders so clients never forget.
whatYouGet: Admin panel to manage all bookings

local-seo-google-presence.title: Local SEO & Google Presence
local-seo-google-presence.description: Get found when customers search for your services on Google — in your city, state, and worldwide. Optimise your Google Business Profile and build local citations so your business appears before competitors in search results.
whatYouGet: Google Business Profile setup and optimisation
Local keyword targeting for your city
Local location pages added to your website

website-redesign-speed-fix.title: Website Redesign & Speed Fix
website-redesign-speed-fix.description: If your current website looks outdated, loads slowly, or isn't showing on Google — fix it. A redesign makes it look better and work better: faster loading, better mobile experience, more enquiries.
whatYouGet: Full visual redesign to current standards

business-dashboard.title: Business Dashboard
business-dashboard.description: A private dashboard showing your business performance in one place — enquiries, orders, bookings, and revenue. No more checking five different apps. Everything your business generates in one screen.
whatYouGet: Custom metrics relevant to your business
Mobile-friendly for checking on the go
